description: Turn Markdown (GitHub-flavoured) into a clean, paginated A4/Letter/A5 PDF: headings, paragraphs with word wrap, bold/italic/strikethrough, inline code, links (clickable), bullet / numbered / task lists (nested), tables (wrapped cells, header repeated on new pages), blockquotes, code blocks, horizontal rules, local images (relative to the Markdown file; remote images are never fetched and show as alt text), page breaks (\pagebreak, \newpage or <!-- pagebreak -->), page numbers, margins and title metadata. Text uses the built-in PDF fonts: Latin text only (English and Western European). Arabic, CJK and other scripts are not supported yet: such characters are replaced with "?" (or rejected with onUnsupportedChar: "error"); emoji are dropped; arrows and common symbols are transliterated. Give "markdown" inline or "path" to a .md file.

font.description: Body font: sans (Helvetica) or serif (Times). Code is always Courier.

fontSize.description: Body font size in pt. Default 10.5.

onUnsupportedChar.description: What to do with characters the PDF fonts can't show: replace with "?" (default) or fail.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

pageNumbers.description: Print "n / total" at the bottom of each page. Default true.

path.description: A .md file: local path or base64. Relative image links resolve against its folder.

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

title.description: PDF title metadata. Default: the first # / ## heading.

name: ai_markdown_to_pdf
title: Markdown to PDF
